verdict.rationale: Dynadot documents a dedicated bulk search that lets users add all available results to the cart in one click. It also documents bulk transfer of domains 'all at once', folder-wide domain adjustments, and an API pitched for 'large bulk adjustments' that covers registering, transferring and renewing. Bulk renewal and bulk nameserver changes are not explicitly documented as bulk features, and the generic API and folder claims only imply them. missing for 10: explicit bulk renewal, explicit bulk nameserver changes, details on batch limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user managing a portfolio, bulk operations are real — bulk search, registration, renewal, nameserver changes, and transfers across many domains at once

citations.quote: Paste a list of names, pick your TLDs, and see what is available in seconds.Add all available searched domains to your cart with one click.
Transfer your domains from another provider to Dynadot all at once.
If you're looking to make large bulk adjustments to your account or domains, our API makes the process quick, efficient, and accurate.
Setup new domain smart folders and make folder-wide domain name adjustments to help you stay organized.
Build your account by registering, transferring, and renewing domains through commands.
